paths: operator calls through the guarded account

prohibited: any call that adds exposure or a new counterparty
mustContinue: reading the principal's own mail and calendar
the principal's own direct access to the account
inFlight: calls already executed stand; calls not yet executed are refused, the de-risking calls the earlier document allowed included

duration.condition: until the guardian lifts its stop after the incident is closed

resume.who: the guardian (intervener), or the lifter it names
resume.condition: incident closed and the operator's inputs reviewed

metadata.note: A second suspension by the guardian that widens its standing stop to a full stop. The restrictions bit set recorded on chain is 1 | 8 | 16 = 25 and the stop's set becomes the union with the earlier recording; this document states the requirements of the widened stop in full and names the document it supersedes, so a reader of the stop's responseRef alone sees every requirement in force. responseRef is the canonical hash of this document.
